fields.Brand Positioning: Radisson Individuals is Choice Hotels’ upper-upscale soft brand for hand-selected independent and boutique hotels that spark curiosity for untold local stories—offering characterful encounters, vivid settings, and explorer-minded service without rinse-and-repeat chain experiences.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: An exceptional stay where bold design and local culture meet reliable, knowledgeable service—curating immersive encounters that help guests discover each destination’s spirit.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Upper-upscale independent character with curated local culture, bold design, and Explorer’s Compass service.

Owners: Maintain uniqueness while benefiting from Choice infrastructure, awareness, and growth trajectory; hand-selected portfolio positioning.

Choice: Soft-brand entry in upper-upscale white space competing with Autograph, Curio, JdV, and Tribute (industry coverage).
fields.Brand Pillars:
Characterful Encounters — immersive experiences rooted in local culture.

Vivid Settings — bold design embracing each destination’s essence.

Explorer’s Compass — reliable, knowledgeable service that unlocks curiosity.

Hand-selected independence — properties chosen for vision and exceptional service.
fields.Brand History: Radisson Individuals operates 15 hotels with 1,732 rooms across the Americas as of September 30, 2024. The brand was relaunched in 2024 as an upper-upscale soft brand within Choice’s Radisson portfolio in the Americas.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Curious, experience-led travelers who seek independent and boutique hotels with local story and design—willing to pay upper-upscale rates for authenticity backed by a major loyalty and reservations platform.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Upper-upscale soft brand for independent and boutique hotels in the Americas.

Three-pillar guest experience: Characterful Encounters, Vivid Settings, Explorer’s Compass.

Hand-selected properties vs. standardized chain formats.

Choice scale with Radisson brand awareness in the Americas (see Choice Hotels brand materials for RHG ownership outside Americas).
